messages:
dave: Seeing a small but growing spike in invalid-kv errors for quant-lite in ap-northeast during the 23:00 window. Canary at ~2.7%. If it climbs we should soft-pin the runtime regionally and add a fallback route. :eyes:

anika: Can we do region-only soft-pin and a 15% fallback to quant-lite-stable? prefer avoiding global pin. Also want to hold auto-unpin until we push an SDK shim.

matt: SRE note: traces show a mismatch in KV marshaling when clients send truncated prefix tokens; runtime v3.5 handles the older format differently. SDK 2.9 has a shim ready. Recommend blocking auto-unpin until SDK advisory is posted.

deploybot: Automated: soft-pin applied -> scope=runtime:v3.5, model_group=quant-lite, region=ap-northeast, id=pin-2912341234, started=2026-03-26T23:12Z. Auto-unpin disabled while advisory open.

oncall-bot: Alert: invalid_kv_rate 2.7% -> triggered. Monitoring extended to 20m.

anika: Routing change pushed: `route_set region=ap-northeast model=quant-lite split={primary:85, fallback-stable:15}`. Will notify support and affected tenants.

eng-platform: Release note saved: "ap-northeast: regional runtime soft-pin for runtime v3.5 on quant-lite due to KV marshaling mismatch with older SDK clients. Action: upgrade to SDK >=2.9 (patch) or use fallback quant-lite-stable. Pin will be lifted after SDK advisory + 2 healthy canary cycles."

dave: Leaving the pin in place until we get post-shim canary green. I'll update when we either unpin or escalate to rollback. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
